about: Apply for the inflation allowance for UAE national families and individuals under the income limit.
note: Requirements read from the official MOCD service page on the checked date. MOCD fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The ministry is named MOCD in this file; its site is moce.gov.ae. Inflation allowance application. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: UAE citizens with monthly income under AED 25,000
Families: one spouse employed and insured by a pension authority, or retired, or a widowed or divorced head of household with a child under 21
Individuals: senior citizens, or widowed or divorced women aged 45 and over
documents: Detailed salary certificate for the head of household and wives
Identity proof for members with separate family book entries
Divorced applicants: court proof of custody and the children's IDs
channels: MOCD website, sign in with UAE PASS
